card.name: Leading 1 of years in the 1500s-1800s
card.fires_on: The digit 1 that begins a four-digit historical year, such as 1521 or 1798, usually inside parentheses or a date range in history text.

modes.label: Year start in parentheses
modes.description: The first digit of a year in brackets after an event or person.

modes.label: Start of a date range
modes.description: The leading 1 of the first year in a span of years.
